description: Enterprise Pulse sentence templates used by computePulse() in enterpriseService.ts. Deterministic — filled from Gate 8 data, not free LLM text.

templates.sentence: Enterprise is performing strongly. {biggestPillar} has improved {biggestGain} points this week. {topRec}
Enterprise is healthy. {biggestMoverDescription}. {bottleneck} remains the largest bottleneck. {topRec}
Enterprise needs attention. OIS is at {ois}/100. {bottleneck} is the priority this week. {topRec}
Enterprise health is below threshold. Immediate focus required on {bottleneck}. {topRec}

variables.biggestPillar: Name of the pillar with the largest positive week-on-week move
variables.biggestGain: Points gained by the biggest mover
variables.biggestMoverDescription: One sentence describing the biggest mover
variables.topRec: Top Gate 8.2 recommendation, formatted as a single sentence
